name: John Gregory Jacobs
finding: Contemporary Fifth Estate establishes September 27, 1969 Detroit arrest and next-morning remand in Wayne County Jail. Individual bail release unknown. This is separate from October Chicago case and requires a distinct case, not replacement of Chicago dates.

name: Jane Alpert
finding: Surrender sources conflict on November 14 versus November 17, 1974; surrender alone does not establish prison admission. Existing January 1, 1975 and August 1, 1977 endpoints lack verified day-level evidence in this pass. Later criminal contempt sentence October 1977 must not be conflated with prior bombing sentence. NYT original articles could not be opened; do not use mirrored excerpts to invent custody endpoints.

name: Kent Ford
finding: Research locates early February 1970 acquittal after nine-day trial, not a release two weeks after arrest. Existing June 14 arrest versus June 18 incarceration may reflect separate police encounters; original newspaper packet needs examination. No endpoint inferred from trial date.

name: Ralph Ginzburg
finding: Existing February 17 to October 10, 1972 interval matches contemporary AP captions. No new arrest date established. Selected interval reviewed; biography not edited.
